summary: Mountain Lake Acquisition Corp. (MLAC), a SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting shareholder votes at its June 4, 2026 extraordinary general meeting. Proposal 1 seeks approval of a business combination agreement with Avalanche Treasury Company and related entities, dated October 1, 2025. Under the agreement, MLAC would combine with the target via merger with Avalanche Treasury and sponsor-related parties. The filing reports vote results but does not disclose deal terms like price per share or premium. Board recommendation and advisors are not specified in this excerpt. The combination is subject to shareholder approval and regulatory conditions. Watch for completion timeline and potential redemptions, as SPAC mergers carry risk-arb uncertainty around trust proceeds.
